title: OccupancyEvent
description: Validated computer-vision occupancy detection event. Note: lighting is decoupled and handled via a separate contract; lighting must NOT be reported as a CV detection.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier used for idempotent ingestion and deduplication.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone offset when the frame was processed.

occupancy.description: Count of detected occupants. Must be a non-negative integer.

confidence.description: Detection confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0, or null if unrated.
